  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 27, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the January 13, 2020, meeting.

  2. Natural Gas Systems, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  maintenance services for the Fleet Division.

  3. Gravotech – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for maintenance and
  training on the City sign machine.

  4. Teresa Estrada – Executive session to discuss recommended reimbursement for the line
  barricades purchased for the Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony.

  5. Long Beach BMW – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  maintenance and repair of four Police motorcycles.

  6. L.A Business Printing – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  services of printing and graphic design for the 2020 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr, Day
  celebration.

  7. Elevate Culture Presents – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  services on additional talent for Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day Celebration.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 27, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference on
the 9th floor at 11:36 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, City Treasurer
  Ken Campos, Legal

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes- Parks and Rec
  Micah Herd- Police Department
  Dominque Ybarra - Finance

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of January 13, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Natural Gas Systems, Inc. – Item pulled.

  3. Gravotech - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  maintenance and training in the amount of $999.99. Motion carried unanimously.

  4. Teresa Estrada- Executive session to discuss recommended reimbursement for the
  purchase of barricades for the Tree Lighting Ceremony in the amount of $458.92.
  Motion carried unanimously.

  5. Long Beach BMW - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  maintenance and repairs for the Police Motorcycles in the amount of $6,205.08. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  6. L.A Business Printing - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  services of printing and graphic design for the celebration of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr
  Day in the amount of $2,838.00. Motion carried unanimously.
 Claims Review Committee  January 27, 2020

  7. Elevate Culture Presents - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  services of additional talent for the celebration of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr Day in the
  amount of $4,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:08 p.m. Adjournment
